DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 27 s. 2022 APR 20 2022 DIR. MARIA LOURDES L. AGUSTIN Regional Director, DILG-NCR 4th Floor, Annex Building-SRA Sugar Center Compound, North Ave. Diliman, Quezon Clty Dear RD Agustin: This pertains to your Memorandum dated 31 January 2022 forwarding to the Central Office the letter dated 27 January 2022 of Engr. Mario D. Cruz, Jr., Acting Punong Barangay (PB) of Barangay Carmona, Makati City, requesting the Department the following: i. Whether the designated officials are authorized to sign any Barangay Development Plan (BDP) and Barangay Development Investment Plan (BDIP) matters; and ii. Whether the designated officials are allowed to participate in public bidding for 2021 and 2022 Annual Investment Plan (AIP) Budget Acting PB Cruz, Jr. and several other Acting Sangguniang Barangay Members of Barangay Carmona, Makati City were designated by the DILG Secretary pursuant to DILG Memorandum Circular (MC) No. 2019-21, re: "OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES AND RULES IN IMPLEMENTING ADMINISTRATIVE ORDER NO. 15 SERIES OF 2018", because of the suspension imposed against PB Joselito M. Salvador and seven (7) other Sangguniang Barangay Members. Hence the instant clarification from Acting PB Cruz, Jr. At the outset, Section 46 of RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 provides: "Section 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. - (a) When the governor, city or municipal mayor, or punong barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice- govemor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking sangguniang barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions Of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. " The aforequoted provision provides the remedy in cases of temporary vacancy in the "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO. : 8876-34-54

Office of the Local Chief Executive, stating among others that the Acting PB shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned. One of the duties and functions of a PB pursuant to Section 389 of the LGC is to prepare the annual executive and supplemental budgets of the barangay. Hence, the queries propounded herein should be answered in the affirmative. Be that as it may, we recommend for Acting PB Cruz, Jr. and the designated SB Members to consider visiting the "PRIMER ON BARANGAY DEVELOPMENT PLANNING" published by the Department, for their guidance. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, UTHORITYO THE SECRETARY: T B. DIN creta for Barangay Affairs Und BNMB/LLLs-LRALLD/rrao/c1p Page 2 of 2
